arguments.request: Require a logged-in user (Flask view decorator)

request: Add a `login_required` decorator that redirects unauthenticated users to the login page, then apply it to the views that need it.

summary.result_text:
I added `login_required` and the `/settings` view now uses it. The other views are still on `authed_only`, and I haven't run the tests or the app.

- **The decorator:** It's in `CTFd/utils/decorators/__init__.py`, built from the catalog pattern `decorators.authed_only@v1` with the `# pcat:` marker kept. `check_code` reported no deviations. A logged-in user goes through, API (JSON) and event-stream requests get a 403, and anyone else is redirected to `auth.login` with `next=` set to the page they asked for.
- **`authed_only` was never defined:** About a dozen modules import and use it, including `views.py`, `users.py`, `teams.py`, `events` and `api/v1/*`, but nothing defined it. I set `authed_only = login_required` so those imports resolve again and plugin code keeps working.
- **Views it protects:** `/settings` is the only protected view in `views.py`, and the other public views there (`/setup`, `/tos`, `/files` and so on) don't need it. The views that already carried `@authed_only` in the teams, users, events and API modules are covered through the alias.
- **Renaming the rest:** I tried a `sed` rename across those modules, but it needed approval and was blocked. If you want them renamed to `login_required`, say so and I'll redo it. The alias works either way.

input.query: Require a logged-in user Flask view decorator redirect to login

input.request: Require a logged-in user (Flask view decorator)

input.command: git status --short | head; grep -rn "authed_only\b" --include=*.py . | grep -v "^./tests" | grep -v "@authed_only"; grep -rn "login_required" --include=*.py . | head
python -c "import CTFd" 2>&1 | tail -3; grep -n -B1 -A3 "@views.route\|@authed_only" CTFd/views.py | sed -n 1,200p | grep -n "route\|authed_only\|def " | head -60
grep -rlw "authed_only" --include=*.py CTFd | grep -v "utils/decorators/__init__.py" | xargs sed -i 's/\bauthed_only\b/login_required/g' && git diff --stat

sed -i 's/\bauthed_only\b/login_required/g' CTFd/views.py CTFd/users.py CTFd/teams.py CTFd/events/__init__.py CTFd/api/v1/users.py CTFd/api/v1/challenges.py CTFd/api/v1/teams.py CTFd/api/v1/tokens.py CTFd/api/v1/solutions.py CTFd/api/v1/unlocks.py CTFd/api/v1/shares.py
